Who We Are

A Volunteer-Run Charity Opening the Canal to All

We're a volunteer-run charity who has been offering canal trips to people across the West Midlands and beyond for over 50 years. We provide day trips for community and family groups, especially those with elderly, disabled, or special needs members, as well as individuals facing health challenges.

Our narrowboat Enterprise starts from Hatherton Marina and cruises the beautiful Staffs & Worcs Canal to Coven, Autherley Junction or Penkridge — each route a unique experience. A peaceful day on the water brings relaxation, connection, and enjoyment to all aboard.

The Benefits

A peaceful canal day brings relaxation and enjoyment to all, letting passengers and volunteers appreciate the history and scenery of the West Midlands region.

📍

Starting Point

All trips depart from Hatherton Marina, WV10 7DT — with free secure parking and easy vehicle access close to the boat for passengers with mobility needs.

♿

Accessibility First

Ramp, hydraulic lift, accessible toilet, and space for up to two wheelchair users. We'll do everything we can to accommodate your group's needs.

🛡️

Safety & Expertise

All skippers hold the NCBA Certificate in Community Boat Management. Enhanced DBS checks and £10m Public Liability Insurance on every trip.

Three Great Routes

Choose Your Perfect Trip

All trips run April to October, 7 days a week. Starting from Hatherton Marina, Wolverhampton.

🍺

Coven Trip

5–5½ hours · Lunch stop included

A leisurely round trip to the Anchor pub at Coven, with a 1–2 hour stop for lunch. Perfect for groups who want a relaxed, sociable day out.

£110 per boat
Book
⚓

Autherley Trip

6 hours · Junction cruise

Cruise to the historic Autherley Junction with the Shropshire Union Canal. A non-stop journey with a brief stop to stretch your legs.

£140 per boat
Book
🔒

Penkridge Trip

8 hours · 12 locks

The full adventure — 12 locks through beautiful Staffordshire countryside. Passengers can help operate locks or simply sit back and enjoy.

£170 per boat
Book

"Prices are per trip for the whole boat — up to 12 passengers. Food is not included. Trips run April to October, 7 days a week."

Full Trip Details
Narrowboat Enterprise

Nearly 50 Years of Serving Our Community

Originally built in 1978 by Cammell Laird apprentices, Enterprise has been specially adapted for passengers with mobility needs. She carries up to 12 passengers with ramp access, a hydraulic lift, large picture windows, central heating, and an accessible toilet — everything needed for a comfortable and safe day on the canal.

Built in 1978 as Symphony by Cammell Laird apprentices for the Peter Le Marchant Trust, incorporating materials from naval destroyers. Refurbished and renamed Walsall Enterprise in 1981 to offer outings for Walsall residents, then transferred to the HF Truman Trust in 2005. Renamed simply Enterprise in 2020, upgrades over the decades include new engines, lifts and facilities.

In 1965, dedicated youth leaders in Walsall raised funds for a narrowboat, leading to the launch of HF Truman in 1968. The group became the HF Truman Narrowboat Trust charity in 1992, moving to Hatherton Marina in 1981. Renamed Truman Enterprise Narrowboat Trust in 2006 after acquiring the 70ft Enterprise from Walsall MBC Social Services.

Our volunteers are passionate about the inland waterways of the West Midlands. We want to promote the benefits of a great day out on the canal to groups who might otherwise find it difficult to access the countryside. We care about our passengers and will try to accommodate everyone's needs.

Words from Our Passengers

We had a nice leisurely cruise through beautiful countryside, saw baby ducks, herons, geese. A beautiful way of getting together and spending time together while being on the canal. We all really enjoyed ourselves. Thank you very much for making it possible with the wheelchair.

Canal Trip — 2025
"

From first contact, all the way through to the day itself and safe arrival back at the marina, everything has been perfect — wonderful beyond words. You've enabled us to form a special collective memory.

Canal Trip — 2025
"

Thank you for a lovely trip. We've never been before, so it was a great experience seeing how the locks work. Lovely friendly crew and excellent scones.

Our Trips

Three beautiful routes along the Staffs & Worcs Canal — April to October

Destinations

Choose Your Trip

We run trips to 3 destinations on the Staffs and Worcs Canal. All trips start and finish at Hatherton Marina, Queens Road, Calf Heath, Wolverhampton WV10 7DT. Trips run April to October, 7 days a week.

🍺 Coven Trip

Most popular destination

£110

A 5 or 5½ hour round trip to the Anchor pub at Coven, including a 1–1½ hour stop for lunch.

⏱Duration: 5–5½ hours
👥Capacity: Up to 12 passengers
💷Cost: £110 for the whole boat
Lunch OptionTimingsStop

ℹ️ Price does not include food. Fish & chips not available on Sundays.
Book This Trip

⚓ Autherley Trip

Junction cruise

£140

A non-stop 6 hour round trip to Autherley Junction with the Shropshire Union Canal, including a stop to stretch your legs if time permits.

⏱Duration: 6 hours
👥Capacity: Up to 12 passengers
💷Cost: £140 for the whole boat
Lunch OptionTimingsStop
Own food10:30am – 4:30pm20 mins
Fish & chips (cash)10:30am – 4:30pm20 mins
ℹ️ Price does not include food. Fish & chips not available on Sundays.
Book This Trip

🔒 Penkridge Trip

Adventure through 12 locks

£170

An 8-hour non-stop round trip to Penkridge, passing through 12 locks. Energetic passengers can experience mooring, steering and lock operation — or just sit back, relax and let the crew do all the work!

⏱Duration: 8 hours
🔒Locks: 12 locks
👥Capacity: Up to 12 passengers
💷Cost: £170 for the whole boat
Lunch OptionTimingsStop
Own food9:30am – 5:30pmNon-stop
Take-away (Cross Keys pub)9:30am – 5:30pmNon-stop
ℹ️ Price does not include food.
Book This Trip
More Information

What to Expect

Narrowboat Enterprise is a 70ft canal boat designed especially for carrying passengers with mobility issues. It has:

  • Ramps & hydraulic passenger lift
  • Seating for up to 12 passengers (minimum 2 leaders/staff required)
  • Large open front deck
  • Small kitchen with fridge & 2 gas burners
  • Large open cabin with deep picture windows
  • Central heating
  • Accessible toilet
  • Free hot & cold drinks for all passengers
  • Qualified skipper and crew member on every trip
  • Free secure parking at the Marina

Crew Competency

Each trip has a skipper and crew member who have passed the appropriate course accredited by the National Community Boats Association (NCBA). All Trust skippers hold the Certificate in Community Boat Management (CCBM). Crew members hold a Community Crew Course (CCC) certificate. All crew undertake update training annually.

DBS Checks

The designated skipper and crew on every trip are required to undergo an enhanced DBS check.

Risk Assessments

The Trust undertakes risk assessments which are regularly reviewed. Risk assessments are available on request.

Insurance

The Trust carries Public and Employer Liability Insurance of £10,000,000 in each instance. Our current insurance certificate is on display on board the Enterprise.

Payment may be made by cheque or by BACS — details will be shown on your invoice.

For BACS payments, please refer to your invoice for our bank details and quote your invoice number or trip date to ensure your payment is allocated correctly.

Payment is due 28 days before each trip. Receipts are available on request.

For any queries about payments, contact Chris Rogers:
📞 07763 214524
✉️ treasurer@truman-enterprise.org.uk

Get Involved

Join our team of dedicated volunteers and make a real difference

Volunteering

Be Part of Something Special

Our trust is dedicated to providing memorable canal boat experiences for elderly and disabled members of our community. Every trip we offer brings joy, connection, and a sense of freedom to those who might otherwise miss out. We can only continue this vital work with your support.

⚓

Volunteer as a Crew Member

Love being on the water? Like meeting new people? Under the supervision of an experienced skipper, our crew members are essential to every trip. Help with lock operations, interact with passengers, and ensure everyone has a safe and enjoyable experience. No previous experience necessary — just enthusiasm and a caring nature. Full training provided.

🚢

Train to be a Skipper

Experienced boat crew can volunteer to be trained as a skipper — the person in charge of each trip. Good boat handling skills needed and full training provided by our NCBA qualified trainer. You'll gain valuable skills while making a real difference to people's lives.

📋

Administrative Support

Behind every boat trip is careful planning and coordination. We need volunteers to help with booking systems, maintaining passenger records, scheduling trips, coordinating volunteers, and general office administration.

📣

Marketing & Communications

Help us spread the word! We're looking for volunteers to manage social media, create promotional materials, write newsletters, take photos during trips, maintain our website, and help with community outreach. Your skills could help us reach more people who would benefit from our services.

🎪

Fundraising & Events

Support our financial sustainability by helping organise fundraising events, writing grant applications, managing donor relationships, or coordinating charity activities. Every pound raised keeps our boat running and our community thriving.

🔧

Maintenance & Technical

Do you have practical skills? We need help with boat maintenance, equipment checks (especially cleaning and painting), ensuring our disabled lift operates safely, general repairs, and keeping our marina facilities in good condition. Your expertise keeps us safe and operational.

🏛️

Trustee & Governance

Join our board of trustees and help shape the future of our organisation. We welcome people with skills in finance, legal matters, charity governance, or strategic planning. Usually requires attendance at quarterly meetings.

💛

Donating Your Time

Whatever your skills, interests or available time, there's a way you can help. Whether you can spare a few hours a month or want to make a regular commitment, every contribution matters. You'll join a friendly team of dedicated volunteers who share a passion for making our waterways accessible to all.

Benefits

Why Volunteer With Us?

✓
Meet like-minded people — join a warm, welcoming team
✓
Learn new skills — from boat handling to marketing
✓
Gain boating experience — including NCBA accredited training
✓
Make a genuine difference — to your local community
✓
Enjoy time on beautiful canals — in the West Midlands countryside
✓
Full training and support — provided in your role

Ready to Get Involved?

Contact us today to discuss how you can support our trust. No commitment necessary — just get in touch for an informal chat about the opportunities available.

📞 Call Jenny: 07895 053090✉️ volunteer@truman-enterprise.org.uk

Support Our Trust

Help us keep the Enterprise sailing for generations to come

Help Needed!

Please help our small charity to buy a new, accessible, hybrid narrowboat so our fabulous team of volunteers can continue providing day trips for people who are elderly, disabled, unwell or disadvantaged on the South Staffs canals.

We are looking to replace our current boat, Enterprise, after 50 years of brilliant service to hundreds of community groups and families. A new boat will give our passengers and volunteers more modern, comfortable and convenient facilities — and our trips can continue for many years to come.

Raised so far: £67,000Target: £100,000

£33,000 still needed — please help us reach our goal

Make a Donation
How to Help

Ways to Support Us

🏦

BACS Transfer

Make a direct bank transfer — the easiest way to donate. Please use your name or organisation as a reference so we can thank you.

BankUnity Trust Bank
Account NameTruman Enterprise NB Trust
Account No.20316185
Sort Code60-83-01
✉️

Cheque

Send a cheque payable to Truman Enterprise Narrowboat Trust to our Treasurer, Chris Rogers.

Contact Chris for the postal address:
treasurer@truman-enterprise.org.uk
07763 214524
💰

Donate on Board

Small or large cash donations can be made on board the Enterprise in the donation tin during your trip. Every penny goes directly towards maintaining our boat and funding future trips.

🎯

Sponsor a Trip

Sponsor a boat trip for a community group who struggle to afford one. You can nominate a group, or we will find one for you. A wonderful way to give back.

Enquire About Sponsorship
📝

Other Financial Help

As a small charity we welcome any financial donation, large or small. Every contribution helps us maintain the boat, cover running costs, and continue providing trips for those who need them.

Contact our Treasurer for other ways of giving:
treasurer@truman-enterprise.org.uk
🤝

Volunteer Your Time

Your time and energy are just as valuable as financial support. From crewing the boat to admin and fundraising — there are many ways to get involved with our friendly team.

See Volunteering Roles
Get in Touch

Questions About Donating?

Contact our Treasurer Chris Rogers for any queries about donations or other ways of giving.

✉️ treasurer@truman-enterprise.org.uk📞 07763 214524

Together, we can ensure that everyone in our community has the opportunity to experience the joy and tranquillity of our canal heritage.

Need Help Booking?

If you have any queries about your trip or completing this form, please contact our bookings secretary:

📞07895 053090
✉️enterprise@truman-enterprise.org.uk
📅 Season: Trips run April to October, 7 days a week.

💳 Payment: Due 28 days before each trip. Payable by cheque or BACS (details on invoice).

📍 Start point: Hatherton Marina, Queens Road, Calf Heath, Wolverhampton WV10 7DT.

♿ Accessibility: Up to 2 wheelchair users per trip. Ramp and hydraulic lift available.
